answer_1.quote: Conversational speech synthesis (CSS) systems are required to generate speech with conversational interaction prosody, unlike traditional text-to-speech (TTS) systems.
answer_1.outputs: synthesized speech with conversational interaction prosody

answer_2.quote: For objective evaluation, we compute the Mean Absolute Error of Pitch (MAE-P) and Mean Absolute Error of Energy (MAE-E) to assess the prosody of the synthesized speech. Additionally, we measure the Mel Cepstral Distortion (MCD) between the synthesized and ground-truth speech to evaluate synthesis quality.

answer_4.quote: For subjective evaluation, we use the Dialogue-level Mean Opinion Score (DMOS). The evaluation is conducted by 20 graduate students specializing in speech, all of whom have passed CET-6, IELTS, or TOEFL exams and have extensive experience in DMOS assessments.
answer_4.guideline: Following the setup in , we employ a 1-5 scale for Naturalness DMOS (N-DMOS) and Prosody DMOS (P-DMOS) to evaluate the quality and prosodic performance of the synthesized speech.
